purpose: Machine-readable curriculum. An agent can grade a learner's answer by running the `spl` of a mission and comparing with `expect`. Figures are exact and stable across reloads unless `stable` is false.

traps: timestamps shifted by whole days: weekday names are an artifact
secure-2 has only 8 distinct timestamps: never use it for time exercises
categoryId holds the literal string NULL in 2041 events on top of 22364 absent ones
the optimizer rewrites stats count by _time into tstats, which buckets by day

missions.spl: index=tutorial | stats count by host, source, sourcetype | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie status=200 | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie "200" | stats count

missions.ask: web events with no action field
missions.spl: index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie NOT action=* | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie action!=purchase | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | top limit=1 clientip
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | timechart span=1h count | where count>0 | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | stats dc(status)
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | eval state=case(isnull(categoryId),"absent",categoryId=="NULL","literal",1==1,"real") | stats count by state
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | bin _time span=4h | stats count by _time | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | stats count by date_hour | sort - count | head 1
missions.note: date_hour is not zero-padded; strftime(_time,'%H') would give 03

missions.spl: index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | stats dc(JSESSIONID)
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | stats count dc(clientip) dc(JSESSIONID) sum(bytes) avg(bytes)
missions.note: the lab rounds the mean to 2097.7

missions.ask: rows of host x status (observed pairs only)
missions.spl: index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | stats count by host status | stats count

missions.ask: events above the overall mean size
missions.spl: index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | eventstats avg(bytes) as m | where bytes>m | stats count

labs.title: Lookups and subsearches
labs.requires: lookup definitions prices_lookup and http_status_lookup, created by the learner in M1

missions.spl: | inputlookup prices.csv | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=vendor_sales | lookup prices_lookup Code OUTPUT product_name sale_price | stats sum(sale_price) as revenue by product_name | sort 1 -revenue
index=tutorial sourcetype=vendor_sales | lookup prices_lookup Code OUTPUT price sale_price | stats sum(price) as c sum(sale_price) as p | eval lost=round(c-p,2)
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | lookup http_status_lookup status OUTPUT status_type | stats count by status_type
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | lookup http_status_lookup status OUTPUT status_type | where isnull(status_type) | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie action=purchase [| inputlookup prices.csv | where price>30 | fields productId] | stats count
index=tutorial sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | stats count as n count(eval(status>=500)) as err | eval rate=round(err*100/n,3)
